snippet.title: Touhou Emblem - Shrine Maiden & Ordinary Magician on the way to unite all of Gensyoko (Chapter 1&2)
snippet.description:
This is the outdated version btw.
Story: An incident happens in Gensyoko again, they lost most of their powers (and some other weird stuff happen), and suddenly certain weapons are everywhere and everyone are using them to resolve battles. Yukari sent the Shikigami duo, Ran & Chen to assist Reimu and Marisa on their way to unite all of Gensyoko.

First chapter ain't that difficult provided you can exploit attack ranges to attack enemies that are unable to counter long-range attacks from magic usesrs.

Characters introduced:
Chapter 1
Reimu Hakurei - Shrine Maiden of Paradise - Starting Class: Miko - Role: Main character, jack-of-all-trades Light magic user - Joins: Immediately
Marisa Kirisame - The Ordinary Magician - Starting Class: Witch - Role: Main character, flying glass cannon that can steal items - Joins: Immediately
Ran Yakumo - Shikigami of the Gap Youkai - Starting Class: Medic - Role: Jagen archetype (crutch character) prepromote combat healer with swords - Joins: Immediately
Chen - Shikigami of the Shikigami of the Gap Youkai - Starting Class: Fencer - Role: Fragile speedster melee unit with good evasion - Joins: Immediately

Chapter 2
Cirno - Ice Fairy of the Misty Lake - Starting Class: Mercenary - Role: Psuedo-Glass Cannon sword melee - Joins: After defeating her, Chapter 3 start
Daiyousei - Nameless Greater Fairy - Starting Class: Archer - Role: Critical-based magic/flying killer, uses bows, ranged unit - Joins: After defeating Cirno, Chapter 3 start
